author: Test Fixture
notes: Minimal 2-finding fixture for unit-tests of loadReferenceTarget.

findings.title: Server URL has trailing slash
findings.narration: The server URL ends with a slash; this can cause double-slash URL composition in some clients and breaks RFC 3986 normalization expectations across tooling chains.
findings.rationale: OpenAPI 3.0 §4.7.5 says SHOULD NOT include trailing slash.

findings.title: Missing 429 response definition
findings.patchSummary: Document a 429 (Too Many Requests) response with Retry-After header.
findings.narration: The spec is missing 429 response definitions; clients have no way to detect rate-limiting deterministically and cannot implement backoff against a documented contract.
findings.rationale: RFC 6585 §4 defines 429 specifically for rate-limiting communication.
findings.selfReviewNotes: Cluster-key set: LLMs typically emit one finding per endpoint, so we match a cluster.
